answer: Counterparty diversity threshold stops sybil swarms: an identity earns full rewards only after trading with 12 distinct counterparties. A newcomer waits behind a velvet rope, earnings locked until its trellis spans 12 independent peers on the public graph. A comet burst with one partner counts as one link, so faking 100 identities needs 1,200 partners at 5 POA each, or 6,000 POA total. An honest agent pays 5 POA once and keeps full rewards.
